outlet: WhyMCA Spring 2010 - Mobile Developer Conference, Politecnico di Milano (Bovisa)
title: Mobile security and privacy (scheda intervento / abstract)
note: Official talk page on whymca.org (Wayback capture 20100413051917, read from the server). Full Italian abstract on enterprise mobile security plus an English draft outline (mobile vs IT security, OS security models, GSM/UMTS/SMS/MMS/Bluetooth/WiFi/NFC attack vectors, economic risks). Ends with 'Nome e Cognome: Fabio Pietrosanti Orario: 10:50-11:35 Tag Speech 2010 Approvato'. The slides (SlideShare 4392945) and the 2010-06-02 blog post are already in media.json; this official event page is not.

title: Sicurezza dei dispositivi e delle comunicazioni mobile: An in-depth overview
note: OUT OF WINDOW (2011), found as a by-product and missing from media.json. The official talk page (Wayback 20110522002605) gives the abstract (security models of iPhone/Android/Blackberry/Nokia S60; SSL/TLS stacks on smartphones; crypto export control) and 'Relatore: Fabio Pietrosanti, Sala/Track: Crossplatform, Slot: 10:30 - 11:20, Giorno: Venerdi, May 20, 2011'. Also listed on the agenda pages https://web.archive.org/web/20110427040216/http://www.whymca.org/agenda/dev-conf-hackaton-maggio-2011 and https://web.archive.org/web/20110522190737/http://www.whymca.org/agenda-mobile/.
